identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of BL-B01D1 in Combination With Osimertinib as Perioperative Therapy in Patients With EGFR-mutated Resectable Non-small Cell Lung Cancer(PANKU-Lung09)
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase II/III Randomized Controlled Clinical Study of BL-B01D1 in Combination With Osimertinib as Perioperative Therapy in Patients With EGFR-mutated Resectable Non-small Cell Lung Cancer(PANKU-Lung09)

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This trial is a registrational Phase II/III, randomized, open-label, multicenter study to evaluate the efficacy and safety of BL-B01D1 in combination with osimertinib in resectable EGFR-mutant non-small cell lung cancer.

armGroups.label: BL-B01D1+Osimertinib
armGroups.description: Participants receive BL-B01D1+Osimertinib in the first cycle (3 weeks). Participants with clinical benefit could receive additional treatment for more cycles. The administration will be terminated because of disease progression or intolerable toxicity occurring or other reasons.

armGroups.label: Osimertinib
armGroups.description: Participants receive Osimertinib in the first cycle (3 weeks). Participants with clinical benefit could receive additional treatment for more cycles. The administration will be terminated because of disease progression or intolerable toxicity occurring or other reasons.

armGroups.label: Carboplatin + Pemetrexed or Cisplatin + Pemetrexed
armGroups.description: Participants receive Carboplatin + Pemetrexed or Cisplatin + Pemetrexed in the first cycle (3 weeks). Participants with clinical benefit could receive additional treatment for more cycles. The administration will be terminated because of disease progression or intolerable toxicity occurring or other reasons.

interventions.name: BL-B01D1
interventions.description: Administration by intravenous infusion for a cycle of 3 weeks.

interventions.name: Osimertinib
interventions.description: Oral administration for a cycle of 3 weeks.

interventions.name: Carboplatin
interventions.description: Administration by intravenous infusion for a cycle of 3 weeks.

interventions.name: Pemetrexed
interventions.description: Administration by intravenous infusion for a cycle of 3 weeks.

interventions.name: Cisplatin
interventions.description: Administration by intravenous infusion for a cycle of 3 weeks.

primaryOutcomes.description: MPR is defined as the presence of viable tumor tissue ≤10% in the surgical specimen at the time of tumor resection.

secondaryOutcomes.description: pCR is defined as the absence of any residual tumor (lesions) in the primary tumor upon surgical resection.
EFS is defined as the time from randomization to the occurrence of any of the following events, whichever occurs first.
Overall survival (OS) is defined as the time between the day the subject is randomized and the subject's death.

TEAE is defined as any unfavorable and unintended change in the structure, function, or chemistry of the body temporally emerging, or any worsening (i.e., any clinically significant adverse change in frequency and/or intensity) of a pre-existing condition during the treatment of BL-B01D1. The type, frequency and severity of TEAE will be evaluated during the treatment of BL-B01D1.
Frequency of anti-BL-B01D1 antibody (ADA) will be investigated.
